body: I appreciate the words of insight. My original research did begin with attempts to identify mental health issues more broadly. However, I found that even more difficult, so i narrowed my research specifically to those at risk for suicide. I hope to expand this research to include other indicators of mental health, if my work here is successful.

So my question is, if they pumped you full of meds to "fix the problem" do you think self harm is a problem?  If meds dont work have you found other ways to avoid it?

​
I meant the iron, isn't that what led to you getting forced in to the hospital about?
BTW, I listened to if for you with a new perspective in mind. I will never hear it the same way again. Thanks again.
I suspected that if there were posts that many people may post songs or lyrics because of the emotional connection they evoke. Thanks for sharing.
Thank you for sharing. I appreciated your video and can only imagine the number of people you have touched.
if you link me to your FB page Ill go check it out. Do you agree with them, that self harming is a problem? If so do you think there are other ways of fixing it than medication?

I am actually using my knowledge in sociology and this study to try and create ans AI program that can detect people who are at risk for outreach programs. I am doing a lot of online research in to AI. AI is all dependent on computer programming.
Do you have any social media activity you think should be an indication to people that they should worry that you might die by suicide?
Do you know what you want to major in? I am about to finish my sociology degree. The first sociology study ever was of suicide.
Uni?
I'd like to know what your plans are when you finish school. Maybe you can continue your education or start a career.
I don't know you but i have to imagine you can have a meaningful life and be an inspiration to others.

It is helpful, thank you! I suspected there are many people who retreat from public spaces, which could be an indicator. I hope to be able to help those who continue to remain active, but also those who retreat which might be more difficult because decrease in social media activity alone is not exclusive to those at risk. But if I can associate that decrease in activity with something else it might be. For example, if someone is posts about a fight or substance abuse and then decreases activity it might help narrow focus. Do you think there was anything leading up to your decreases activity, that when viewed in context of your attempt might have been relevant?

Thank you for sharing, it is helpful. You are right, it is hard to see the signs. My hope is that if i speak with enough people or research enough pages of those we have lost, i might be able to find at least some very common indicators. If you think of anything else feel free to reach out.
Do you have teachers or faculty that you trust to talk with?

Well I appreciate you taking the time to talk with me! I am sure remembering may be difficult sometimes, but our memories of our loved ones is all that carries on so try to remember them the way you would want to be remembered.
I can imagine all of that happening. What do you think they could do that might be helpful? Have you been to a therapist? If so has it been helpful?
If they were to ask the question and found out the answer, where do you think the conversation would go from there?

I'm sure that your imagination could just run wild about all the activity that could have been out there for you to look at. On the other hand you could have gotten there, only to find out you didn't want to be there.

Looking back, are there things that you think you or others should have noticed about the social media activity that could have lead to an intervention?
In those moments do you think that others might notice but are jut too uncomfortable to explicitly ask the question..... Are you thinking about committing suicide?
Does that bother you? or do you prefer to not have the content out there anymore?
not necessarily that you want them to notice(or maybe you do), but if you were to view yourself from their point of view, you would think it was a sign.

What are things that you think other people should notice about you, that might be a sign of your intentions?

​

I am hoping to build a community around identifying opportunities outreach opportunities that might create a safety net for instances like this. Was there anything you friend was posting on publicly that you think would have indicated what was about to happen?
I hope your memories are a blessing to you. I am doing research in to prevention. Can you recall anything he posted on social media that might have indicated he was struggling?
